claims: NASA is currently targeting 2027 for the Artemis III mission.
Artemis III aims to test rendezvous and docking capabilities between the Orion spacecraft and commercial lunar landers in low-Earth orbit.
Artemis III's mission goal is to test rendezvous and docking with SpaceX's Starship or Blue Origin's Blue Moon.
The Artemis III crew will launch from Kennedy Space Center on the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis III will focus on docking in low-Earth orbit as part of the preparations for future lunar landings.
Artemis III is a key step before a planned lunar landing on a later mission.
The schedule for Artemis III depends on the success of the preceding Artemis II mission.
The schedule for Artemis III depends on continued development of key components, including the commercial landers and new EVA spacesuits
